column6: No verse makes the Chaldeans descendants of Kesed son of Nahor (GEN 22:22); Ur of the Chaldees stands in GEN 11:28 before he is born. Strong's 'patronymically from' describes how the word is formed, not a genealogy.
No verse makes the Kenites descendants of Cain the son of Adam; Qayin (H7014) is also the tribe's own name (NUM 24:22, JDG 4:11).
Strong's etymology of Kasdiy stays as his statement; no record is made the Chaldeans' forefather on it (GEN 11:28, GEN 22:22).
Strong's etymology of Qeyniy stays as his statement; Cain the son of Adam is not made the Kenites' forefather on it (NUM 24:22, JDG 4:11).
